ciedi.edu.co: 68. The gap: the CSP.

Every internal link that was opened answered, and AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page. But no content security policy.

Lesson: Tighten the content security policy one directive at a time, starting from default-src 'self'.

ghlhoteles.com: 40. The gap: broken links.

Lesson: Check your own links after each release, and fix or redirect every one that answers 404.

samsung.com: 68. The gap: ARIA roles.

Every page has a title, and AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page. But certain ARIA roles must be contained by particular parents.

Lesson: Use native HTML elements first. When you use ARIA roles, nest them the way the role requires.

onepagelove.com: 81. The gap: form labels.

Every internal link that was opened answered, and model-training crawlers are blocked by choice. But 421 form controls have no label.

Lesson: Give every input a visible label tied to it with for and id. Screen readers announce it, and the tap target grows.
